preset.purpose: movement's showcase: only the body, on the metrics course, driven through the engine's input map by an input script (keys and pointer moves). Third-person harness camera, a frame strip every 15 frames. The still is the last frame, with the body at rest, so the test-mode and normal-launch pair can be compared; the end-state hash in the log must be identical in both. Saving the strip disturbs the frames around each save, so this preset's frame-time numbers are not the budget evidence: movement-run-budget is the same run without the strip.

tick_cost_ms.what: wall time of one tick's scripts: every body's move and the instruments watching them
